summary: Registered Nurse with a supervisory background and over a decade of clinical experience across sub-acute, medical-surgical, and intensive care settings. Oversees and delegates work to multidisciplinary nursing teams on a 53-bed sub-acute unit, ensuring policy adherence, safe staffing, and quality care. Core strengths include comprehensive patient assessment, IV therapy, wound care, care plan development grounded in evidence-based practice, management of complex post-surgical and respiratory needs including tracheostomy and mechanical ventilation, cardiac drip and PCA pump management, and interdisciplinary communication with physicians and families. Also delivers staff in-services and patient/family education, and holds critical care and dysrhythmia certifications along with ACLS and BLS.
